name: ZMF Cinema
description: 12-32 screen multiplex cinemas generate in your worlds. Every player starts with a ZMF Cinema Pass that takes them to the nearest one. Films from your own Jellyfin servers or video folders, automatic red/cyan 3D, automatic 4DX, IMAX, ScreenX, web cinemas (with MCEF Modern) and bHaptics TactSuit support.
